lede: A mobilisation target of about 5,000 Non-Resident Bengali patrons alongside about 5,000 village integrated farms — launching from a live showcase at Durga Puja 2026. These figures are a goal, not a completed count, and ₹1 lakh is proposed seed-support, not money already collected.
notice: One village farm. One NRB patron. ₹1 lakh proposed seed per farm. Not collected on this website.

stats.label: village integrated farms (target)
stats.body: Local teams of 2–3 progressive farmers or FPOs put in land, labour and working capital.

stats.label: Non-Resident Bengali patrons (target)
stats.body: Anyone with a native village in Bengal — whether they live abroad or in Kolkata.

stats.label: per farm
stats.body: In full, or ₹20,000 every two months over the year.

stats.label: 5,000 × ₹1 lakh (arithmetic of the target)
stats.body: The mobilisation aim between Puja 2026 and Puja 2027. Not funds already raised.

how.body: Express interest in a village farm, or in cluster or zonal Puja patronage, or name your ancestral district. This website does not complete a pairing or take payment.
